blocks.orig: Inoga Lodge is located near Karatu town, between Tarangire National Park and the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. The lodge is set up on a lovely, clean terrain boasting a swimming pool and communal restaurant, with rooms spread over several little houses. Each room boasts an ensuite bathroom (with bathtub or shower), cable television, a mini-bar, free Wi-Fi and a coffee machine. Meals are served at the restaurant, with dishes prepared based on seasonal ingredients. After your safari, the pool is available for your relaxing moment, and you can sip cocktails at the bar.
blocks.html: Between Tarangire National Park and the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, Inoga Lodge sits close to Karatu town. It is set on lovely, well-kept grounds with a swimming pool and a shared restaurant, and the rooms are divided over several small houses. All rooms have an ensuite bathroom (with a bathtub or a shower), cable television, a mini-bar, free Wi-Fi and a coffee machine. The restaurant serves meals made with seasonal ingredients. After a day on safari you can unwind by the pool and enjoy a cocktail at the bar.
